name: Export all merged documents from a DocupletionForms document set

parameters.content:
## Export all merged documents from a DocupletionForms document set

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfa-intellitech/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms/main/templates/images/bulk-export-merged-documents.png)

**Uses the verified [n8n-nodes-docupletionforms](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms) node — available on n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances.**

### Who's it for
Teams using [DocupletionForms](https://docupletionforms.com) who need to pull every generated PDF for a document set at once — an end-of-month archive, an audit request, migrating documents elsewhere — instead of downloading them one at a time from the dashboard.

### How it works
Run this manually whenever you need a fresh export. It lists every merged document for a chosen document set, then downloads each one as binary data in the same execution.

### How to set up
1. Add your DocupletionForms API credential.
2. Pick the same Document Set on both the List Merged Documents and Download Merged Document nodes.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed — on Cloud, enable it under Settings → Community Nodes; verified nodes are approved for Cloud installs.
- A DocupletionForms account and API key.

### How to customize
Add a node after Download Merged Document to save each file somewhere (Google Drive, S3, the Read/Write Files node) instead of just holding it in the execution output. Replace the Manual Trigger with a Schedule Trigger to run this automatically instead of by hand.

### Step 1
Set up your DocupletionForms credential and pick the Document Set to export.

### Step 2
Pick the same Document Set here too — each node needs it set separately.
